yt_account_connect_hint: Connect your account to see your playlists and liked songs.
yt_account_dialog_steps:
1. On a computer, open music.youtube.com signed in to your account.
2. Open the developer tools, Network tab, and reload the page.
3. Pick a request to music.youtube.com and copy the value of the "Cookie" header.
4. Paste it here.
